name: Charo
source:
An honorable princess on the outside, but a conniving maverick on the inside. She isn’t afraid to use the prince if she can get what she wants. Her two older sisters have already been married off. As the third princess of her kingdom, her marriage is of little worth. Charo lived an uninhibited life, cursing her position in the kingdom for having everything decided based on her rank being below her sisters. But now, with drought threatening to wipe out her country, it is up to Charo to save her kingdom. When Charo sees how small the prince’s kingdom really is, she plans on taking his kingdom for her very own.

[From [url=https://www.kaguragames.com/product/princess-party/]Kagura Games[/url]]
